resources.string: Style
Keyboard themes
Light, dark and AMOLED themes, colors, background images, import and export
Keyboard font
Google Fonts, or import your own font file
Icons
Change any tool icon or key icon, or install an icon pack
Keys
Key corner radius
How round the corners of the keys are
0 gives square keys. 28 gives keys with a full pill shape.
Key label font size
Scale of the labels on the keys
This changes the size of every label on the keys. The popup bubbles have their own font size under Key press → Key popup.
Key hint font size
Scale of the small hint character in the corner of each key

This changes the size of the small hint that the keyboard prints in the corner of a key. The keyboard shows the hint when \"Press and hold hints\" is on. Larger values make the hints easier to read. The default is ×1.00.
Toolbar
Show the toolbar
The strip above the keys that holds the suggestions and the tools

The toolbar is the row above the keys. It shows the word suggestions while you type. At other times it shows your pinned tools, such as emoji, clipboard and cursor keys. Turn it off to give its height to the keys. The app asks you to confirm, because this also hides the suggestions and every tool.
Where the tools go
Share the suggestion strip, or use a row above it

With \"The strip\", the tools and the suggestions share one row. The tools rest there, the suggestions take the row while you type, and the arrow button changes between them. This costs no height. With \"A button\", the arrow button opens a row of tools above the suggestions, and the button closes it again. With \"Always\", that row of tools stays open. Both of the last two keep the tools in reach while you type, and both use the height of one more row.
The strip
A button
Always
Swipe down to hide
Swipe down on the toolbar to close the keyboard

When this is on, a swipe down anywhere on the toolbar closes the keyboard. It is off by default, so the gesture does not start while you scroll or rearrange the toolbar. To move a tool you press and hold it, so that gesture does not close the keyboard.
Only the toolbar with a hardware keyboard
When a hardware keyboard is connected, show only the toolbar

When you connect a Bluetooth keyboard or a dock keyboard, the on-screen keys go away and only the toolbar stays. Emoji, clipboard and the other tools stay one press away while you type on the hardware keyboard. This setting is off by default.
Reverse the order for right-to-left languages
Mirror the order of the tools when you type a right-to-left script
For right-to-left scripts, such as Arabic and Hebrew, the pinned tools also go from right to left, so the toolbar follows the text. This setting is on by default. The toolbox grid does not change.
Spread the tools across the toolbar
The tools share the width of the toolbar equally

When this is on, the tools share the full width of the toolbar, like the word suggestions do. When it is off, they keep a fixed size on the left. You select the tools on the toolbar from the keyboard. Open the toolbox with the grid button on the toolbar. Then press and hold a tool and drag it between the toolbar and the toolbox.
Toolbar height
Height of the toolbar and the suggestion strip

The default is 44 dp. A taller toolbar gives larger targets for your finger and space for the tool labels. A shorter toolbar gives more height back to the screen. This strip shows both the word suggestions and the toolbar.
Scroll the toolbar
Swipe the tools sideways instead of making them smaller

When you pin more tools than the toolbar can show, this keeps each tool at a comfortable size and lets you scroll through them. It puts the tools on the left and overrides \"Spread the tools across the toolbar\". Change the order from the toolbox, because a drag inside a toolbar that scrolls is difficult.
Hide the toolbar and the clipboard on the lock screen
Hide the top strip and block the clipboard while your device is locked

The keyboard opens over your lock screen when you answer a notification or use a search box there. This setting then hides the full top strip and blocks the clipboard panel. The strip holds the word suggestions and every pinned tool, so the clipboard tool and its paste chip also go. Copied text such as one-time codes and passwords stays off a screen that anyone can wake. This setting is off by default. When your device is unlocked, the keyboard does not change.
Tool labels
Show the name of each tool below its icon on the toolbar
The keyboard draws a small name below every pinned tool. Increase the toolbar height to give the labels space.
Label text size
Font size of the tool labels on the toolbar
Tool circle radius
How round the circle behind each toolbar tool is
20 draws a full circle behind every tool icon, like Gboard. Smaller values give rounded squares. 0 removes the background and leaves only the icons.
Tool background shape
Outline of the shape behind each toolbar tool
Tool background width
Width of the shape behind each toolbar tool
38 keeps the classic circle. Wider values stretch it into a pill, like Gboard. The background only shows when the tool circle radius is above 0. Pairs well with the scrollable toolbar.
Toolbox layout
How the toolbox draws its tools
Icons
Pills

Icons is a grid. It shows a round icon for each tool with the name below it. Pills gives each tool a wide row with round ends. The icon is on the left and the name is beside it. An arrow on the right marks the tools that open something, such as Themes and Clipboard. The other tools do their work immediately, such as Flashlight and Undo. Fewer tools fit on the screen, but you can read every name.
Toolbox grid size
Tools in each row of the toolbox grid
The toolbox is the grid behind the grid button on the toolbar. Fewer tools in a row makes each tool larger and easier to press. More tools in a row shows more tools without a scroll.
Pills per row
How many tool pills go side by side
The default is two. One gives every tool the full width, which is good for long names and large text. Three works only in landscape or on a tablet. On a smaller screen the names get cut.
Fill the pills with the tool color
Color the full pill and not only its icon

When this is off, each pill keeps the background of the theme and only the icon shows the color of the tool. When it is on, the pill gets that color. The icon and the name change to a color that you can read on it: white on most colors, almost black on pale colors. This needs \"Colorful tool icons\" (Settings → Tools) to be on. With that setting off, there is no color to fill the pill with.
Swipe the toolbox in pages
Fixed pages that you swipe sideways, and not one grid that scrolls

When this is off, the toolbox is one grid that scrolls up and down. When it is on, the toolbox becomes pages that you swipe between. Dots below the grid show your position. Every tool then keeps the same place, so you can find it from memory. You can drag a tool to a new position inside the page that you see.
Tools per page
How many tools each toolbox page holds
Select a multiple of your row size to fill the last row of every page. If you select more tools than the panel can show, the page scrolls as well as swipes.
%1$d per row
%1$d per page
Turn off the toolbar?

The full top strip goes away. You lose the word suggestions and fast access to every pinned tool, such as emoji, clipboard and cursor keys. The keys use the free height. You can turn the toolbar on again here at any time.
Suggestion text size
How large the words in the suggestion strip are

Key labels have their own size setting and the suggestions above them did not, so large keys could still come with small suggestions. This also sizes the candidate row for Chinese, Japanese and Cantonese input, since it is the same row in a different mode. This setting is 100% by default.
Suggestion spacing
The gap on each side of a word in the suggestion strip

Lower it to fit more of a long word before it has to shrink, or to pack more suggestions onto a narrow screen. Raise it to keep neighbouring words from reading as one when the strip scrolls. This setting is 6 dp by default.
Toolbox label size
The name under each tool in the full tool panel
By default these follow the toolbar label size, so the two agree. Set a size here to make the toolbox names larger or smaller on their own. This setting follows the toolbar by default.
Follow toolbar
Reset appearance
Put every setting on this screen back to its default

The key corner radius, the label and hint sizes, the whole toolbar group and the whole toolbox group go back to their defaults. Your theme, your font and your icon pack are not affected: they have their own screens.
Reset toolbox order
Put the tools in the toolbox grid back in their original order
The tools in the toolbox grid go back to the order they shipped in. Which tools are switched on, and which are pinned to the toolbar, are not affected.
